prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Wide shot. A family in silhouette, in ankle-length rough undyed wool robes and head-cloths, barefoot, standing in tall wet grass under a fading rainbow as the evening sky turns gold, their backs to the camera. Evening glow. Quiet hope. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
